Alle Speisen auch zum Mitnehmen ——————————————— From Monday to Friday we serve you our varied lunch special at Restaurant ROTH for only €10.80 – fresh, fast and above all delicious🍴 👉 Daily from 11:30 am to 3:00 pm – perfect for your lunch break Stop by, enjoy great taste at a small price and let us spoil you ❤️ Restaurant ROTH 📍Währinger Straße 1, 1090 Vienna – we look forward to welcoming you All dishes also for take-away! #LunchBreak #Lunchtime #RestaurantROTH #LunchSpecial #ViennaEats FoodMoments
